title: Offline bundle compatibility matrix (Installer ↔ Bundle) + pilot environments
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-16 (owner: Bruno)
Source of truth for: which on-prem installer versions can install which offline bundle versions; upgrade/downgrade behavior; known caveats from pilots.

Legend
- Installer version: Redwood Private installer binary version (redwood-private-installer)
- Bundle version: Redwood Private offline bundle release version (bundle metadata)
- Signed bundles: bundle contains canonical manifest + detached signature (manifest.json + manifest.sig) and trust roots required
- Trust store: installer contains embedded trust store AND can be pointed at an external trust store file for air-gapped key rotations
- Downgrade protection: installer writes local install state; blocks installing a lower version unless explicit break-glass path is used (policy-gated)
- “Unsigned allowed”: only for pre-signing legacy installs; after GA, policy is “fail closed” by default

TAB 1 — Installer ↔ Bundle compatibility
(Columns: Installer | Bundle | Signed required? | Min installer | Recommended installer | Trust store update needed? | Downgrade protection behavior | Notes)

Installer_Version	Bundle_Version	Signed_Required	Min_Installer	Recommended_Installer	Trust_Store_Update_Needed	Downgrade_Protection	Notes
0.18.x	2025.11-legacy	No	0.18.0	N/A	No	None	Legacy pilot builds; manifest optional. NOT supported for new customers.
0.19.0	2025.12-rc1	Optional	0.19.0	0.19.2	No	Warn-only	Supports reading manifest.json if present; will install unsigned bundles (config flag to require signing).
0.19.2	2025.12-rc2	Optional	0.19.0	0.19.2	No	Warn-only	First stable preflight messaging; still permissive for unsigned.
0.20.0	2026.01.0	Yes (default)	0.20.0	0.20.3	No	Block	First release where signing is ON by default; break-glass supported with --allow-unsigned (audit warning).
0.20.1	2026.01.1	Yes	0.20.0	0.20.3	No	Block	Fixes edge cases in offline bundle path parsing (spaces / Windows separators).
0.20.2	2026.01.2	Yes	0.20.0	0.20.3	No	Block	Adds bundle inspect command output fields used by Support.
0.20.3	2026.01.3	Yes	0.20.0	0.20.3	No	Block	Time-skew guidance + optional diagnostic time override to avoid false “not yet valid” errors.
0.21.0	2026.02.0	Yes	0.20.0	0.21.0	Maybe (if key rotation)	Block	Trust store rollover support (multiple keys) + support bundle wiring. Use if customer is behind on key updates.

TAB 2 — Manifest / signature envelope expectations by bundle series
(Columns: Bundle | Manifest schema | Signature type | Hash algo | Includes SBOM pointer? | Determinism expectations | Notes)

Bundle_Series	Manifest_Schema	Signature_Type	Hash_Algo	SBOM_Pointer	Determinism	Notes
2025.11-legacy	(none / ad-hoc)	None	N/A	No	N/A	Do not use in new pilots. Kept only for historical installs.
2025.12-rc*	v0.9	Embedded (experimental)	SHA-256	No	Best effort	Some RC bundles shipped with embedded signature blob; installer supports but strongly prefers detached.
2026.01.x	v1.0	Detached (manifest.sig)	SHA-256	Optional	Required	Canonical JSON ordering required; signature covers entire manifest bytes (post-canonicalization).
2026.02.x	v1.1	Detached (manifest.sig)	SHA-256	Yes	Required	SBOM pointer + hash included; installer verifies SBOM artifact hash offline if present.

TAB 3 — Upgrade path matrix (supported / blocked / caveats)
(Columns: From installer+bundle | To installer+bundle | Supported? | Expected behavior | Operator steps | Notes)

From	To	Supported	Expected_Behavior	Operator_Steps	Notes
0.19.2 + 2025.12-rc2	0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	Yes	Installer upgrade first, then bundle install with signing enforced	1) Upgrade installer 2) Update trust store if needed 3) Run preflight verify	Most common pilot path.
0.20.0 + 2026.01.0	0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	Yes	In-place upgrade allowed	Provide new bundle; run preflight verify; proceed	No trust store changes.
0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	0.19.2 + 2025.12-rc2	No	Downgrade blocked	Not supported	Even with break-glass, strongly discouraged due to signed manifest + install state.
0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	0.20.3 + 2025.12-rc2	No (default)	Downgrade blocked (bundle version lower)	Requires break-glass + security approval	Break-glass must be logged; see exception process and Support runbook.
0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	0.21.0 + 2026.02.0	Yes	Install state updates; SBOM verification added	Upgrade installer; install new bundle	Recommended for customers requesting SBOM evidence.
0.20.3 + 2026.01.3	0.20.3 + 2026.02.0	Sometimes	May fail if bundle expects manifest v1.1 / SBOM checks not recognized	Prefer upgrading installer to 0.21.0	We should not ship a 2026.02 bundle that requires installer features without documenting it.

TAB 4 — Trust store / key rotation compatibility
(Columns: Key set | First bundle signed with key | Installer versions containing key | External trust store supported? | Notes)

Key_Set	First_Bundle_Signed	Installer_Embedded	External_TrustStore	Notes
RWI-SIGN-001	2026.01.0	>= 0.20.0	>= 0.20.0	Initial signing key. For air-gapped customers, external trust store path is the safest update mechanism.
RWI-SIGN-002 (planned)	TBD (target 2026.03)	>= 0.21.0 (target)	>= 0.20.0	Rollout plan: ship bundles dual-signed during transition OR ship trust store update bundle; finalize after rotation drill.

TAB 5 — Pilot customer environments (for “works in the real world” validation)
(Columns: Customer | Environment | K8s | OS | Air-gap notes | Time source notes | Current installer | Current bundle | Known issues | Status/next action)

Customer	Environment	K8s	OS	AirGap_Notes	Time_Source	Installer	Bundle	Known_Issues	Status_Next
Helios Defense	On-prem (classified enclave)	v1.26.8	RHEL 8.8	USB transfer only; strict no-outbound; require local audit logs	Manual time sync via enclave-approved source; occasional drift	0.20.1	2026.01.1	Hash mismatch once due to unzip tooling; resolved with guidance	On track; retest with 0.20.3 time-skew guidance; collect audit export sample
AsterBank	VPC + restricted subnet (bank security zone)	v1.27.6	Ubuntu 22.04	No outbound; artifacts moved via internal artifact gateway	Has internal NTP; stable	0.20.3	2026.01.3	Requested SBOM proof + key custody documentation	Upgrade to 0.21.0 + 2026.02.0 when available; provide evidence packet
Northbridge Health	On-prem hospital data center	v1.25.11	RHEL 9.2	Offline repo mirror allowed; limited admin access	NTP allowed but intermittently blocked by firewall policy	0.19.2	2025.12-rc2	Preflight verify not enforced; wants clearer errors	Plan: upgrade installer to 0.20.3; move to signed bundles; run Support-guided preflight
GovLab Research	Air-gapped lab environment	v1.26.3	Rocky Linux 8.9	Requires deterministic builds evidence + documented break-glass workflow	No NTP; relies on manual time setting	0.20.3	2026.01.3	Concern about “not yet valid” if clocks wrong; needs SOP	Deliver SOP: check time before verify; use diagnostic override only for debugging; capture audit logs
Ion Fabrication	Factory-floor on-prem	v1.24.17	Ubuntu 20.04	Portable drive transfer; operators not comfortable w/ CLI	Local time drifts; sometimes off by hours	0.20.0	2026.01.0	Operational friction; needs simplified checklist	Provide 1-page operator checklist + scripted “bundle inspect/verify” output for Support

TAB 6 — Known incompatibilities / footguns (keep short + actionable)
Issue	Symptom	Applies_To	Mitigation	Owner
Time skew	Signature “not yet valid” / verification fails	Air-gapped envs without NTP	Document time checks; recommend 0.20.3+; diagnostic override for triage only	Sean Gallagher
Bundle tampered in transit	Hash mismatch on artifact file; manifest verify fails	USB transfer + unzip tools	Use tar + checksum verification; avoid tools that normalize line endings; re-transfer	Dev Patel
Unknown key after rotation	Installer says untrusted signing key	Customers not updating trust roots	Ship external trust store update + docs; support call checklist	Connor O'Brien
Attempted downgrade	Installer blocks install w/ downgrade error	Ops rolling back after incident	Use supported rollback procedure; break-glass requires approval + audit marker	Ethan Park
Unsigned bundle install attempt	Installer blocks install (expected)	Legacy habits	Provide signed bundle; if break-glass used, open support case + remediation plan	Fatima Noor

Notes / TODO (not a tab; working area)
- TODO: Confirm final mapping of installer versions to features:
  - manifest canonicalization behavior (Jordan)
  - trust store search order (embedded vs external path) (Ethan)
  - whether 0.20.3 is the minimum recommended for pilots due to time-skew fix (Sean)
- TODO: Add a column for “requires support bundle vX” once support bundle includes signed bundle metadata everywhere (Logan / Caleb).
- TODO: Align “bundle version” naming (2026.01.3 vs 2026.01.03) — keep exactly what release tooling emits.

Operator quick check (what Support/SE should ask for in tickets)
1) Installer version (exact) + command output: `installer version`
2) Bundle version + build id: `installer bundle inspect --bundle <path>`
3) Verification result + error code (if any)
4) How bundle was transferred (tar/zip, tool used, checksum verification?)
5) Local clock/time source (NTP? manual? drift?)

Change log (manual)
- 2026-02-16: Added 0.21.0 row + SBOM verification note; added GovLab + Ion time-source notes.
- 2026-01-29: Updated downgrade protection behavior to “Block” for 0.20.x; added break-glass policy reminders.
- 2025-12-10: Initial matrix for 0.19.x RCs; added Helios/AsterBank/Northbridge pilot rows.
